create_base_lcm_model: create a BaseLCModel from a BaseLCModelConfig with optional device and dtype parameters
BaseLCModel_forward: run a forward pass on an EmbeddingsBatch through the frontend, LCM transformer, and postnet
BaseLCModel_predict_next_sentence: predict the next sentence embeddings from an EmbeddingsBatch with optional sampling and temperature
BaseLCModelBuilder_build_model: build a complete BaseLCModel by assembling the frontend, core LCM, and postnet modules
BaseLCModelBuilder_build_frontend: build the LCM frontend module that maps SONAR embeddings to model dimensions with positional encoding
